request_payload.title: De novo gain-of-function and loss-of-function mutations of SCN8A in patients with intellectual disabilities and epilepsy.

mentions.sentence: BACKGROUND: Mutations of SCN8A encoding the neuronal voltage-gated sodium channel NaV1.6 are associated with early-infantile epileptic encephalopathy type 13 (EIEE13) and intellectual disability.
